defect_observations.observation: The toc tag '%% toc: P15 172 172.7,172.8,172.9,172.10' places section 172.8 'Elementary effects and regression-based sensitivity' on this chapter, but the chapter has no elementary-effects or regression content. That subject is treated only at handbook/parts/p15/global-sensitivity-and-robustness.tex 149-233, which carries no toc tag. This is a navigation and mapping defect, not a component gap.

The collinearity non-uniqueness sentence is immediately followed by \cite[Section 5.2]{SaltelliAnnoni2010Sensitivity}. Held source Section 5.2 (PDF 5 = p. 1511) covers SRCs, R^2 and the low-R^2 ranking pitfall but says nothing about collinearity. The claim is the handbook's own (proved at annex lines 134-137), so the citation placement may misattribute it.

This proof step relies on 'the measurable-factorization result for real coordinate tuples' but gives no cross-reference. thm:p15-conditional-factorization exists at handbook/parts/p15/conditional-expectation.tex:213.

The held PDF source/references/p15-global-sensitivity/saltelli-annoni-2010.pdf (sha256 fba86067...) is listed with source_ids [] and version null, and source_index has no SaltelliAnnoni2010 key. On inspection it is the two-author Environmental Modelling & Software 25 (2010) 1508-1517 author's personal copy (the queued version, not the Procedia paper), but held-sources does not record this binding.
